acceptance: Enter sends once and Shift+Enter breaks the line; Enter during IME composition never sends; a blank caller placeholder keeps the default one and nothing is sent without a draft; while a turn runs the single action is Stop.

reason: TS leaves pointer selection to CodeMirror so buttons do not take its focus, sizes the composer in CSS, and places its pickers with its own overlay geometry clamped to the Agent panel. The native composer is one text input whose height follows its lines, and its pickers are GPUI anchored overlays above their trigger kept inside the window.

acceptance: The approval dock states its request once (a reason repeating the title is not shown again), says Needs your approval or how many are pending, offers exactly the runtime's decisions (Deny, Allow for session when offered, Allow once) and sends each one, disables them while a decision is being submitted, and states its network target, write scope, reason and any policy change.

A streaming answer catches up in grapheme-safe frames and converges; an incomplete Markdown block stays a plain-text tail until it completes; backtick and tilde fences stay in the tail until their matching close; GFM table rows are promoted one completed row at a time.

A turn that ended degraded shows a recovery with one explicit continuation and folded, provider-neutral details (its code, scope, connection and side effects); continuing keeps the draft and references.

A chat created with a prompt sends it once when it first settles ready (an identical composer echo keeps it armed, a manual edit disarms it); over a runtime that is not ready the prompt stays the draft and is never sent later.
